lemma net_select (f:I→Site n)(hg: ¬ Edition.Spaced b f) :
    ∃ (J:Type) (_:Fintype J) (_:DecidableEq J) (L:Fibers I J),
      L.twig (L.bunch i)=i ∧ Fintype.card J<Fintype.card I ∧ Edition.Spaced b (f ∘ L.twig) ∧ ∀ x:I,separation (f x) (f (L.twig (L.bunch x)))<b^2:=by
    classical
    let p(a : Finset I):= i∈a∧(a:Set I).Pairwise (fun x y=>b^2≤ separation (f x) (f y)); let S:= univ.filter p; have ht x:x∈S↔ p x:=mem_filter.trans (and_iff_right (mem_univ _))
    have hξ:p {i}:= ⟨mem_singleton_self _,by simp⟩
    obtain ⟨s,hp,hh⟩:= Finset.exists_max_image S Finset.card ⟨{i}, (ht _).2 hξ⟩; have hs: i∈s:=(ht s|>.1 hp).1; have he :=(ht s|>.1 hp).2
    have hX (x:I) (hx:x∉s) : ∃ a∈s,separation (f x) (f a) < b^2:=by
       by_contra! h; have hy:p (insert x s):=by
         refine ⟨mem_insert_of_mem hs,fun i hi j hj hij=>?_⟩; rcases mem_insert.mp hi with hi|ht'; subst i
         · exact h j ((mem_insert.mp hj).resolve_left hij.symm)
         rcases mem_insert.mp hj with rfl|hh'; · rw [separation_comm]; exact h i ht'
         exact he ht' hh' hij
       have hu:=hh (insert x s) ((ht _).2 hy); rw [card_insert_of_notMem hx] at hu; omega
    have h₀:∀ x, ∃ j : (↑s:Type), separation (f x) (f j.val)< b^2 ∧ (x∈s→j.val=x):=by
       intro x; by_cases ht:x∈s
       · exact ⟨⟨x,ht⟩, by simpa only [separation_self] using (pow_pos hb 2), fun _=>rfl⟩
       obtain ⟨j,hj,H⟩:=hX x ht; exact ⟨⟨j,hj⟩,H,fun h=> (ht h).elim⟩
    choose K hK hJ using h₀; let F:Fibers I (↑s:Type):= ⟨K,Subtype.val,fun x=> Subtype.ext (hJ x x.property)⟩
    refine ⟨_,inferInstance,inferInstance,F,hJ i hs,?_ ,fun i j hij=> he i.property j.property (mt Subtype.ext hij),hK⟩
    rw [Fintype.card_coe]; refine lt_of_le_of_ne (Finset.card_le_univ _) ?_; intro H; rw [Finset.eq_univ_of_card s H] at he; exact hg (fun i j hij=> he (mem_univ i) (mem_univ j) hij)

proof_context.conclusion: A non-spaced family has a b^2-separated retained subfamily keeping the distinguished index, with strictly fewer groups, and every discarded point within b^2 of its representative.

snippet.text: def carpet (A:History G)(i:ℕ) : ℕ := 16*OPE.haloUnits (A.S.block i) (A.levels.budget i).B (A.levels.budget (i+1)).B

proof_context.conclusion: carpet = 16*haloUnits = 16*(1+L(B+B'+1)^2)^4 bounds the cover number of a joined pair.

lemma bought (hG:G.Simple) (h: HaloGate C.path.levels) (N : ℕ) (hn:0<N): Note C.S (fun i=> license C.path δ N (carpet C.path i) (i+1)) 0:=by
    let x i:= ((P'|>.budget (i+1)).supportExponent+1/2) * carpet C.path i
    have hp : Note C.S (fun i=> Real.exp (x i)) 0:=by
       refine ⟨fun i=> Real.exp_pos _,?_⟩; simp_rw [Real.log_exp]
       have he:Tendsto (fun i=>16*(Real.sqrt (C.path.levels.clock.hatBeta i)/Λ i)) atTop (𝓝 0):= by simpa only [mul_zero] using! ((whence C hG).const_mul 16)
       apply squeeze_zero' _ _ he
       · exact Eventually.of_forall fun i=>div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (add_nonneg (P'|>.budget (i+1)).exponent_pos.le (by norm_num)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) (Shoot.scale_nn _ _)
       filter_upwards with i; rw [← mul_div_assoc]; apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (Shoot.scale_nn _ _); let v:= haloUnits (C.S.block i) (P'|>.budget i).B (P'|>.budget (i+1)).B
       calc _ ≤ 16*(( (P'|>.budget (i+1)).supportExponent+1) * v):= by unfold x carpet; push_cast; rw [mul_left_comm _ (16:ℝ)]; gcongr; norm_num
            _ ≤ _:= mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h i) (by norm_num)
    have hr := (mintN C hG).1.scales C.path.levels.fits.mesh
    unfold license; apply ((((hr.splits (Note.notes C.S (N:ℝ) (by positivity))).mills hr).splits hp).swapP (by norm_num))

proof_context.conclusion: license(carpet i, i+1) is subpower (using the HaloGate entrance requirement and whence), and the running minimum v <= 1 below all these allowances is subpower by the initial-segment/tail argument.

lemma compensated_joint {α:ℕ}{K:Fibers I J} (h: Fintype.card I ≤ H)(ht:Fintype.card J<Fintype.card I)(ha:0<a)(hx:a≤1)(hw:0<w)
    (hr:a ≤ license A δ H α i) (hW:compensation A H i j (Fintype.card I) a w ≤ ∏ x,W x):
    compensation A H i j (Fintype.card J) a w ≤ ∏ x,grouped A δ H α i W K x/8:=by
    let y b:= compensation A H i j b a w; let p:= Fintype.card I; let q:= Fintype.card J; let t:= a/8
    have hy b: 0< y b:=comp_pos ha hw; have hF:0<t:=div_pos ha (by norm_num); have hG:t ≤ 1:= by unfold t; linarith only [hx];
    have hV: 0 < license A δ H α i:=ha.trans_le hr
    have hg: a^H ≤ a^p:= pow_le_pow_of_le_one ha.le hx h
    have hp: (8:ℝ)^q ≤ 8^H:= pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (ht.le.trans h)
    have hU: y q ≤ y p*t^H:=by
       have hz:H*(H-p)+H ≤ H*(H-q):=by calc _ = H*(H-p+1):= by ring
                                                                                     _ ≤ _:= Nat.mul_le_mul_left H (by omega)
       have he:=pow_le_pow_of_le_one hF.le hG hz
       unfold y compensation; change _ * t ^ _ * _ ≤ _ * t^_ *_* t^H
       rw [mul_right_comm _ w, mul_assoc _ _ (t^H), ← pow_add]; refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (pow_pos (div_pos (A.S.a_pos _) (A.S.a_pos _)) _|>.le)) hw.le; exact he
    rw [prod_div_distrib,groupCash,cashIn_a, prod_const,card_univ,le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]; refine le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (hy q|>.le)) ?_
    calc y q*(8:ℝ)^H ≤ (y p*t^H)*8^H := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hU (by positivity)
         _ = a^H * y p := by unfold t; rw [mul_assoc,← mul_pow,div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by norm_num),mul_comm]
         _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul (hg.trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ ha.le hr _)) hW (hy p|>.le) (pow_pos hV _|>.le)

proof_context.conclusion: A fusion from |I| to |J| < |I| groups is paid by factors alpha/8 in the compensation weight.
